items.name: HubLabs/HubEgo-100K
items.description: HubEgo-100K 🔴 Release 2 is live (23 Nov 2026): +10,000h added. A 100,000-hour dataset of first-person video of skilled manual work, recorded by Hub contributors: building sites, workshops, salons, kitchens, shops, warehouses and homes, released in stages. Releases 1 and 2 together have 20,113 hours of RGB + IMU from 21,259 contributors, in LeRobot and MCAP formats. Paper: HubEgo-100K: In-the-Wild Egocentric Video of Skilled Work for Robot Learning (arXiv:2611.21938 [cs.RO])

items.name: FINAL-Bench/World-Model
items.description: 🌍 World Model Bench (WM Bench) v1.0 Beyond FID — Measuring Intelligence, Not Just Motion WM Bench is the world's first benchmark for evaluating the cognitive capabilities of World Models and Embodied AI systems. 🎯 Why WM Bench? Existing world model evaluations focus on: FID / FVD — image and video quality ("Does it look real?") Atari scores — performance in fixed game environments WM Bench measures something different: Does the model think correctly?
